preconditions.description: The jumble of letters must be a non-empty string.
Each word in the dictionary must be a non-empty string.
All characters in the jumble must be alphabetic characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char.isalpha() for char in word) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: All characters in each word in the dictionary must be alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The result must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in result)
postconditions.description: Each item in the result must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(jumble) == sorted(word) for word in result)
postconditions.description: Each word in the result must be a rearrangement of the jumble.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in result)
postconditions.description: Each word in the result must be in the dictionary.
The result must contain the same words as in the dictionary, in the same order.
